chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (AS), who said:
“A father is not executed for killing his son, but a son is executed for killing his father.”
And he said: “Two men do not inherit from one another when one of them has killed the other.”

key_terms.لَا يَتَوَارَثُ: do not inherit from one another
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is subject to execution in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a father killing his son, and does a killer inherit from the one he killed?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliatory execution in cases of intra-family killing: a father is not executed for killing his son, while a son is executed for killing his father. It also states that mutual inheritance is barred between two individuals when one has killed the other.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5244 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Baṣir from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"A father is not executed for killing his son, but a son is executed for killing his father."
Imam (as) also said: "Two men who kill one another do not inherit from each other."
